+    def scope_to_group(self, recipe: Recipe) -> Recipe:
+        """Apply the zip-import group checks for tools and sub-recipe references to a parsed recipe.
+
+        Used by importers that build `Recipe` objects themselves. Only `tools` and each ingredient's
+        `referenced_recipe` are rewritten; every other field is left untouched. The recipe is changed
+        in place and returned.
+        """
+        tools: list[RecipeTool] = []
+        for tool in recipe.tools:
+            resolved = self._transform_tool(tool.model_dump(mode="json"))
+            if resolved is not None:
+                tools.append(RecipeTool.model_validate(resolved))
+        recipe.tools = tools
+
+        for ingredient in recipe.recipe_ingredient:
+            reference = ingredient.referenced_recipe
+            if reference is None:
+                continue
+
+            kept = self._transform_referenced_recipe({"id": str(reference.id) if reference.id else None})
+            if kept is None:
+                ingredient.referenced_recipe = None
+
+        return recipe
+

+import json
+from io import BytesIO
+from typing import Any
+from zipfile import ZipFile
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from mealie.schema.group.group_migration import SupportedMigrations
+from mealie.schema.recipe.recipe_tool import RecipeToolSave
+from tests.utils import api_routes, random_string
+from tests.utils.assertion_helpers import assert_deserialize
+from tests.utils.fixture_schemas import TestUser
+
+
+def _recipe_json(name: str, tools: list[dict], ingredients: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "slug": name,
+        "description": "",
+        "recipeIngredient": ingredients,
+        "recipeInstructions": [{"text": "mix"}],
+        "tools": tools,
+        "tags": [],
+        "extras": {},
+    }
+
+
+def _build_archive(migration: SupportedMigrations, recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
+    buf = BytesIO()
+    with ZipFile(buf, "w") as zf:
+        if migration is SupportedMigrations.mealie_alpha:
+            zf.writestr(f"export/recipes/{recipe['slug']}/{recipe['slug']}.json", json.dumps(recipe))
+        else:
+            zf.writestr(f"{recipe['name']}/recipe.json", json.dumps(recipe))
+    return buf.getvalue()
+
+
+def _migrate(api_client: TestClient, user: TestUser, migration: SupportedMigrations, recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    response = api_client.post(
+        api_routes.groups_migrations,
+        data={"migration_type": migration.value},
+        files={"archive": _build_archive(migration, recipe)},
+        headers=user.token,
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    report = assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.groups_reports_item_id(response.json()["id"]), headers=user.token))
+    assert report["entries"]
+    assert all(entry["success"] for entry in report["entries"]), report["entries"]
+
+
+migrations = [SupportedMigrations.mealie_alpha, SupportedMigrations.nextcloud]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("migration", migrations, ids=lambda m: m.value)
+def test_migration_foreign_tool_is_not_moved(
+    api_client: TestClient, unique_user: TestUser, g2_user: TestUser, migration: SupportedMigrations
+) -> None:
+    other_name = random_string()
+    other_tool = g2_user.repos.tools.create(RecipeToolSave(name=other_name, group_id=g2_user.group_id))
+
+    recipe_name = random_string()
+    recipe = _recipe_json(
+        recipe_name,
+        tools=[{"id": str(other_tool.id), "name": random_string(), "slug": other_tool.slug}],
+        ingredients=[{"note": "salt"}],
+    )
+    _migrate(api_client, unique_user, migration, recipe)
+
+    untouched = g2_user.repos.tools.get_one(other_tool.id)
+    assert untouched is not None
+    assert str(untouched.group_id) == str(g2_user.group_id)
+    assert untouched.name == other_name
+
+    imported = assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.recipes_slug(recipe_name), headers=unique_user.token))
+    assert len(imported["tools"]) == 1
+    assert imported["tools"][0]["id"] != str(other_tool.id)
+    assert imported["tools"][0]["groupId"] == str(unique_user.group_id)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("migration", migrations, ids=lambda m: m.value)
+def test_migration_keeps_own_tool(api_client: TestClient, unique_user: TestUser, migration: SupportedMigrations) -> None:
+    own_tool = unique_user.repos.tools.create(RecipeToolSave(name=random_string(), group_id=unique_user.group_id))
+    recipe_name = random_string()
+    recipe = _recipe_json(
+        recipe_name,
+        tools=[{"id": str(own_tool.id), "name": own_tool.name, "slug": own_tool.slug}],
+        ingredients=[{"note": "salt"}],
+    )
+    _migrate(api_client, unique_user, migration, recipe)
+
+    imported = assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.recipes_slug(recipe_name), headers=unique_user.token))
+    assert [t["id"] for t in imported["tools"]] == [str(own_tool.id)]
+
+
+def _create_recipe(api_client: TestClient, user: TestUser) -> dict:
+    name = random_string()
+    response = api_client.post(api_routes.recipes, json={"name": name}, headers=user.token)
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    return assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.recipes_slug(response.json()), headers=user.token))
+
+
+# The nextcloud migrator runs ingredients through the scraper cleaner, which flattens every ingredient
+# value to text, so a structured sub-recipe reference cannot arrive through it; only mealie_alpha can.
+reference_migrations = [SupportedMigrations.mealie_alpha]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("migration", reference_migrations, ids=lambda m: m.value)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("by", ["id", "slug"])
+def test_migration_foreign_referenced_recipe_is_dropped(
+    api_client: TestClient, unique_user: TestUser, g2_user: TestUser, migration: SupportedMigrations, by: str
+) -> None:
+    other = _create_recipe(api_client, g2_user)
+    reference = {"id": other["id"]} if by == "id" else {"slug": other["slug"]}
+    reference.update(name=other["name"])
+
+    recipe_name = random_string()
+    recipe = _recipe_json(recipe_name, tools=[], ingredients=[{"note": "sub", "referencedRecipe": reference}])
+    _migrate(api_client, unique_user, migration, recipe)
+
+    imported = assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.recipes_slug(recipe_name), headers=unique_user.token))
+    assert imported["recipeIngredient"][0]["referencedRecipe"] is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("migration", reference_migrations, ids=lambda m: m.value)
+def test_migration_keeps_own_referenced_recipe(
+    api_client: TestClient, unique_user: TestUser, migration: SupportedMigrations
+) -> None:
+    own = _create_recipe(api_client, unique_user)
+    recipe_name = random_string()
+    recipe = _recipe_json(
+        recipe_name,
+        tools=[],
+        ingredients=[{"note": "sub", "referencedRecipe": {"id": own["id"], "slug": own["slug"], "name": own["name"]}}],
+    )
+    _migrate(api_client, unique_user, migration, recipe)
+
+    imported = assert_deserialize(api_client.get(api_routes.recipes_slug(recipe_name), headers=unique_user.token))
+    assert imported["recipeIngredient"][0]["referencedRecipe"]["id"] == own["id"]

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+
+from mealie.lang.providers import get_locale_provider
+from mealie.schema.recipe.recipe import Recipe
+from mealie.schema.recipe.recipe_ingredient import RecipeIngredient
+from mealie.schema.recipe.recipe_tool import RecipeToolSave
+from mealie.services.recipe.recipe_service import RecipeService
+from tests.utils import random_string
+from tests.utils.fixture_schemas import TestUser
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def service(unique_user: TestUser) -> RecipeService:
+    user = unique_user.repos.users.get_one(unique_user.user_id)
+    household = unique_user.repos.households.get_one(unique_user.household_id)
+    assert user and household
+    return RecipeService(unique_user.repos, user, household, translator=get_locale_provider())
+
+
+def test_scope_to_group_only_touches_tools_and_references(service: RecipeService, unique_user: TestUser):
+    recipe = Recipe(
+        name=random_string(),
+        description="desc",
+        recipe_servings=4,
+        extras={"k": "v"},
+        recipe_ingredient=[RecipeIngredient(note="salt", title="Seasoning", quantity=2)],
+    )
+    before = recipe.model_dump()
+
+    result = service.scope_to_group(recipe)
+
+    assert result.model_dump() == before
+
+
+def test_scope_to_group_drops_unknown_reference_and_foreign_tool(
+    service: RecipeService, unique_user: TestUser, g2_user: TestUser
+):
+    foreign = g2_user.repos.tools.create(RecipeToolSave(name=random_string(), group_id=g2_user.group_id))
+    recipe = Recipe(
+        name=random_string(),
+        tools=[{"id": foreign.id, "name": foreign.name, "slug": foreign.slug}],  # type: ignore[list-item]
+        recipe_ingredient=[
+            RecipeIngredient(note="a", referenced_recipe=Recipe(id=uuid4(), name="ghost", slug="ghost")),
+            RecipeIngredient(note="b", referenced_recipe=Recipe(name="slug-only", slug="slug-only")),
+        ],
+    )
+
+    result = service.scope_to_group(recipe)
+
+    assert [i.referenced_recipe for i in result.recipe_ingredient] == [None, None]
+    assert len(result.tools) == 1
+    assert result.tools[0].id != foreign.id
+    assert str(result.tools[0].group_id) == str(unique_user.group_id)
